payload.reason: The evidence provides metrics for evaluating performance differences, specifically character accuracy (CHA) and word accuracy (WOR), which can explain the performance variations between the DICTA test set and the new test set.

claims.text: The difference in performance between the DICTA test set and the new test set can be attributed to the metrics used for evaluation, specifically character accuracy (CHA) and word accuracy (WOR).

Character accuracy (CHA) measures the portion of characters in the text that are correctly represented, while word accuracy (WOR) measures the portion of words with no mistakes, which can lead to different performance outcomes.
